name: VXW Spin The Wheel Television Championship
epitaph: Its own stipulation is set by a spin of a wheel before every defense; Mike Bisignano won it from Valec Corso through a table at Birthday Bash 2005 and carried it through ladder match defenses at Vegas Violence V and Fear Is Coming II, before losing it to Lark Fenriz inside the Rage In The Cage cage match at Phear Phantastic 2005. Fenriz retained it against Justin Harper on Winter War I after a disqualification reversal, then lost it to Harper on Winter War II inside a triple threat also involving Kagedo. Harper retained the title in a scored Taipei Death Match against Roman Anderson at St Patricks Day Massacre.

name: VXW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Hot Property, "All That" Austin Lee and "Hotstuff" Stevie Knight, surviving a draw against Team Brittania, a defense against The Rhombus, and a three-way title match at Vegas Violence V that Team Brittania won by disqualification without taking the belts. Survived a publicly rejected stripping rumor on Setting Sun I and a double-pin, no-decision Tornado Tag Team defense against The O'Malley Brothers on Christmas Comes Early, then a scored Irish Street Fight against the same challengers on New Years Eve Of Destruction, before losing the belts to the O'Malley Brothers at Ghost Town Blues in a Tables Ladders and Chairs match; the O'Malleys retained the titles in their own first defense, against Team Brittania at St Patricks Day Massacre, on a disqualification.

name: VXW 24 Hour Championship
epitaph: Held by Thunder Valenkov, defended successfully against Robbie Caldwell and, in a match that ended The Maquilladora's own career, at Vegas Violence V, then again against Adam 'The Hype' Jennings on New Years Eve Of Destruction, before losing it to Jennings at Ghost Town Blues inside a Russian Cage Match; Jennings retained the title in a rematch against Valenkov at St Patricks Day Massacre.

name: VXW Submission Championship
epitaph: Stands defunct; Iyasu Saku is remembered on VXW's own broadcasts as its former champion, with no surviving document recording when or how the title stopped being defended.

name: VXW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: A past championship named only in retrospect at a retiring wrestler's own farewell tribute; The Maquilladora and Classy Joey Boy are both billed as former holders, with no surviving document dating either reign.

name: VXW Spin The Wheel Championship
epitaph: A new title created on the spot at Phear Phantastic 2005, awarded to the first non-champion who pinned another non-champion inside the Rage In The Cage cage match; Damian Payne won it in his own second VXW appearance, pinning Justin Harper with Kagedo's own illegal assistance. Retained in a Table For Two match against Omega on Christmas Comes Early, before losing it to Cobra at Xtreme Machine I in an escapes-only steel cage match and regaining it from Cobra twelve days later at St Patricks Day Massacre.
